> 19 page(s) of platform.claude.com documentation — Api — Admin under Analytics. Part of the index one level up (../llms.txt).

## Analytics

- [Artifacts](https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/api/admin/analytics/artifacts.md): Get artifact-creation activity for a given day, broken out by MIME type.
- [Chat Projects](https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/api/admin/analytics/chat_projects.md): Get per-project activity for a given day, with cursor-based pagination.
- [Connectors](https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/api/admin/analytics/connectors.md): Get per-connector usage for a given day, with cursor-based pagination.
- [Cost](https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/api/admin/analytics/cost.md): Get cost in USD over time across a date range.
- [Get Activity Summaries](https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/api/admin/analytics/retrieve_summaries.md): Get organization-wide activity summaries for a date range.
- [Get Artifact Activity](https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/api/admin/analytics/artifacts/list.md): Get artifact-creation activity for a given day, broken out by MIME type.
- [Get Chat Project Usage](https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/api/admin/analytics/chat_projects/list.md): Get per-project activity for a given day, with cursor-based pagination.
- [Get Connector Usage](https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/api/admin/analytics/connectors/list.md): Get per-connector usage for a given day, with cursor-based pagination.
- [Get Cost Over Time](https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/api/admin/analytics/cost/list.md): Get cost in USD over time across a date range.
- [Get Per-User Cost](https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/api/admin/analytics/cost/list_by_user.md): Get per-user cost in USD across a date range.
- [Get Per-User Token Usage](https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/api/admin/analytics/usage/list_by_user.md): Get per-user token usage across a date range.
- [Get Plugin Usage](https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/api/admin/analytics/plugins/list.md): Get per-plugin install + invocation usage for a given day, with pagination.
- [Get Skill Usage](https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/api/admin/analytics/skills/list.md): Get per-skill usage for a given day, with cursor-based pagination.
- [Get Token Usage Over Time](https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/api/admin/analytics/usage/list.md): Get token usage over time across a date range.
- [List User Activity](https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/api/admin/analytics/users/list.md): Get per-user activity for a given day, with cursor-based pagination.
- [Plugins](https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/api/admin/analytics/plugins.md): Get per-plugin install + invocation usage for a given day, with pagination.
- [Skills](https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/api/admin/analytics/skills.md): Get per-skill usage for a given day, with cursor-based pagination.
- [Usage](https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/api/admin/analytics/usage.md): Get token usage over time across a date range.
- [Users](https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/api/admin/analytics/users.md): Get per-user activity for a given day, with cursor-based pagination.
